records.title: perf(lsp): resolve Git inputs once per refresh
records.release_claim: one request-local resolved Git-input record drives refresh identity, deduplication, snapshot, and status
records.reason: Repeated unshared base resolution can disagree inside one accepted refresh and adds avoidable process latency; unresolved inputs now fail closed rather than fabricating identity.
records.non_claim: This is not a global Git cache and does not change CLI diff semantics.

records.title: feat(lsp): filter code-action commands by the negotiated riprEditor profile
records.release_claim: client-executed actions are emitted only when the negotiated editor profile advertised their command IDs
records.reason: Without one filter choke point a server can offer commands that the client cannot execute or silently drop commands the VS Code client does support.
records.non_claim: Server-executed commands remain separately governed and riprAgent remains unsupported.

records.title: feat(lsp): honor CodeActionContext.only and restore kind parity
records.release_claim: code actions honor requested hierarchical kinds and every emitted kind belongs to the advertised set
records.reason: Ignoring context.only or emitting an unadvertised bare source kind violates the LSP action contract and can present unsupported actions.
records.non_claim: The reserved source.ripr.verify kind remains advertised but unemitted until a producer exists.

records.title: feat(lsp): stable InvalidParams rejection for unsupported executeCommand IDs
records.release_claim: unsupported or client-owned executeCommand IDs fail with one stable typed rejection instead of silent success
records.reason: Returning Ok(null) for commands the server never executed fabricates successful execution to generic clients.
records.non_claim: The rejection path does not add handlers or execute client-owned commands.

records.title: test(lsp): pin push/pull code-action availability parity
records.release_claim: push and pull diagnostic clients receive the same ordered code-action availability for the same stored evidence
records.reason: The single selection authority is incomplete unless action availability—not only diagnostics—stays transport-equivalent; the breakage experiment proves the test discriminates.
records.non_claim: Presentation ordering parity does not authorize disabled or unsupported actions.
